Istituto Comprensivo di Borgo San Giuseppe (CN) is a state comprehensive school (codice meccanografico CNIC847004) based in the Oltregesso area of Cuneo and covering the nearby town of Castelletto Stura. It runs 11 sites: 3 preschools (infanzia), 6 primary schools, and 2 lower-secondary schools (medie). The head of school is Lorenzo Busciglio.

The Sleep Disorders Clinic offers a full range of diagnostic and therapeutic sleep services, including night time sleep studies and daytime tests. Our 3 locations contain private bedrooms and we perform sleep studies 7 nights a week. Most services are covered by OHIP and all new patients require a referral from their family doctor or specialist. Sleep studies are offered in Hamilton, St Catharines and Cambridge Memorial Hospital.
